mapper.sql: id, sector_code, sector_name, sector_type, parent_id, description, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM stk_sector WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM stk_sector WHERE sector_code = #{sectorCode} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM stk_sector WHERE sector_type = #{sectorType} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT FROM stk_sector WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sector_type, sort_order
SELECT FROM stk_sector WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND sector_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY sector_type, sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stk_sector (sector_code, sector_name, sector_type, parent_id, description, sort_order, status, create_time) VALUES (#{sectorCode}, #{sectorName}, #{sectorType}, #{parentId}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE stk_sector SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
